MODE-FORKED, and the fork is FORCED, not chosen: a mode-invariant AA-text value is ARITHMETICALLY IMPOSSIBLE (vs #FFFFFF needs L<=0.1833, vs #1A1A1A needs L>=0.2215 — the window is empty). light #DA1A00 = 4.503 on #FFFFFF; dark #F6604C = 4.763 on #1A1A1A (unchanged from -glyph). Ground set EXCLUDES the two rag tints per s134-D4 (ink sits on the pastel SHAPE, not the tint). SCOPE is coloured text only — information and warning coloured text are OUT by Dave's word, not used. Named -ink not -text because rag/text/* is ground-keyed (on-light/on-dark/on-information) while this rung is mode-keyed with hue as the meaning. Consumer: amount-display.sign (s143-D1(B), bind STANDS).
